title: Start new reproducible independent candidate discovery
objective: Find reproducible independent LONG and SHORT sleeves that can add trade count and total R to the current four live-capable sleeves without pretending to recover P16 or P19.
first_deliverables: closed-bar causality and historical/live parity tests
required_order: freeze current four-live-sleeve benchmark and six-sleeve historical reference
commit discovery contract before performance inspection
save all raw proposals before deduplication or outcome filtering
run label-free density regime direction time and overlap audit
evaluate with expanding purged walk-forward and Strong/Extreme costs
persist any future model pipeline feature order calibration thresholds and proposal scores
do_not_repeat: P16 or P19 exact recovery attempts without new artifacts
live_runtime_modification_exception: Only a demonstrated defect may be fixed during discovery.
